name: Slate Frontmatter Configuration
description: Structure documentation for the YAML frontmatter in Slate API documentation pages (index.html.md). Controls page title, language tabs, table of contents, search, and meta tags.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Page title displayed in browser tab and page header

fields.name: language_tabs
fields.description: Programming language tabs for code samples in the right panel. Items are Rouge lexer names (string) or {lexer: label} objects.

fields.name: toc_footers
fields.description: HTML links or text displayed at the bottom of the navigation sidebar

fields.name: includes
fields.description: Markdown include file names (without extension) from source/includes/ to concatenate into the page

fields.name: search
fields.description: Enable full-text search in the documentation sidebar

fields.name: code_clipboard
fields.description: Show copy-to-clipboard buttons on code blocks

fields.name: meta
fields.description: HTML meta tags to inject into the page head for SEO

fields.name: image
fields.description: URL or path to the logo image

fields.name: link
fields.description: URL to navigate to when logo is clicked
